messages:
Lina: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortemwe need clear owners for the rollout/canary improvements. I want concrete deliverables and dates so this doesn't sit.

Marco: I'll take the canary orchestration changes (canary window, weighting ramp). ETA: 2026-04-14 for a staging PR, 2026-04-21 for prod rollout plan.

Jesse: I'll do auto-rollback wiring and the rollback audit events. ETA: 2026-04-11 for a prototype. Blocker: need a stable way to query model variant health per instance.

Nadia: I'll handle the recurring-patterns analysis (incident clustering + heatmap) and add it to the incident board. Report by 2026-03-29.

sre-bot: Low-traffic deploy window: 2026-04-18 03:00-05:00 UTC. Add the `pre-deploy-check` tag to PRs.

Lina: For clarity: Marco -> canary orchestration (TKT-6011), Jesse -> rollback + telemetry (TKT-6012), Nadia -> incident pattern analysis (TKT-6013). Please link tickets when created.

Marco: Canary config proposal (sketch):
```yaml
canary:
  ramp:
    - pct: 2
      duration_min: 30
    - pct: 10
      duration_min: 60
  success_criteria:
    error_rate: < 0.015
    p95_latency_ms: baseline + 40
  rollback_policy: auto|manual
  max_blast_radius_pct: 5
```

Asha: Suggestion: require a minimum traffic sample for each stage (e.g., min_requests: 300) otherwise skip stage. Otherwise noise causes false rollbacks.

Marco: Good point. I'll add min_requests to the schema.

Jesse: Rollback event schema (plan): `rollback.triggered` with tags: route, variant_from, variant_to, reason, metric_window, triggered_by. Will post the draft schema in TKT-6012.

QA: Please ensure the canary comes with automated smoke tests that validate both correctness and latency. We'll attach smoke test jobs to the staging pipeline.

Lina: On ownership: add a line in each ticket for "who runs the first 3 canary deploys" and "who owns post-rollback triage". We need human owners for the first responder.

Nadia: From incident clustering, we found 3 recurring patterns: 1) model misconfig leading to alignment errors during bursts, 2) region-specific disk pressure leading to degraded KV-cache hits, 3) sudden p95 jumps after config reload. I'll include example traces.

Marco: For pattern #3 we should add a preflight check after config reload to verify latency on a small set of routes before continuing rollout.

Jesse: Proposal: auto-rollback triggers only if either (a) sample_size >= min_requests AND metric breach persists for N consecutive windows OR (b) blast_radius_pct >= emergency_threshold. We'll encode this in the controller.

Asha: Ops request: add a manual override key in the UI to pause auto-rollback for emergency maintenance windows. Must be audit-logged.

Lina: Timelines recap: TKT-6011 (Marco) canary schema PR by 2026-04-14, staging runbook + smoke tests by 2026-04-18. TKT-6012 (Jesse) rollback prototype + telemetry by 2026-04-11, schema PR by 2026-04-16. TKT-6013 (Nadia) incident patterns report by 2026-03-29.

Marco: Adding sample YAML for blast-radius gating to the ticket:```yaml
flag: new_rewrite_engine
gating:
  initial_pct: 2
  max_pct: 10
  region_scopes: [us-east-1]
safety:
  min_requests: 300
  auto_rollback: true
  rollback_window_min: 5
  rollback_thresholds:
    error_rate: 0.02
    p95_delta_ms: 45
```

Jesse: I'll ensure the `rollback.triggered` event includes a `rollback_cause` enum so we can filter postmortem dashboards easily.

Nadia: Will also add a weekly recurring job to surface new clusters to platform-ops so we can proactively mitigate.

Lina: Please paste ticket links back here once created. Ill review mid-week and we'll put this on the ops sync agenda. If owners miss dates, escalate to leads. :exclamation:

sre-bot: Reminder: add `deployment-checklist` label to any PRs touching rollout/canary/rollback logic.

Marco: Created TKT-6011: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-6011 (WIP PR at https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2895).

Jesse: Created TKT-6012: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-6012. Draft rollback schema posted.

Nadia: Created TKT-6013 and uploaded the incident cluster heatmap.

Lina: Thanks. Closing thread for now I'll follow up on any slippage.

Asha: One last ops note: add retention of rollback events for 90 days and index on route + variant for faster queries.

Jesse: Noted. Will add to TKT-6012 as an implementation detail.
